design: categorical effect-coded D-optimal; mandatory controls plus coordinate exchange
initializer: all features zero; common attribute/logratio encoder block; common nonzero latent input columns; Selector final zero; Compensation zero output, nonzero extra columns for linear head to avoid dead bilinear branch
feature_interpolation: linear raw ratio; endpoint clamp; no extra modulation network
selection: original cached-uniform Bernoulli, selected-only opacity ST; original compact renderer; hard same-K margin diagnostic

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.implementation: PyTorch fused CUDA, same implementation in all formal arms

schedule: one shuffled Bank camera per cycle, ratio1/5/10/15 in order; no early stop; common seed schedules

screen.ranking: mean PSNR on held-out Bank cameras, equal weights seven ratios

validation: each fifth Bank camera held out; training only remaining cameras; no map/camera optimization; source Master itself previously saw Bank

confirm.candidates: top3 distinct screen configs + best all-shared + original16 shared baseline + latest16+8 baseline + best selector-depth2 + best compensation-depth2, deduplicate; plus matched R3 reference
confirm.checkpoint_selection: final12000 only; 4000/8000/12000 curves for convergence, not test-driven step choice

final_scene.name: fr2_xyz
final_scene.source: one fresh default R3 SLAM map, then freeze same map for all finalists
final_scene.configs: locked fr1 validation winner + original16 shared baseline + R3 reference
final_scene.test: non-Bank views fixed before quality; no architecture reselection using this scene

statistics.primary: equal mean PSNR across seven ratios on held-out Bank for architecture selection
statistics.interval: paired seed plus contiguous camera-block hierarchical bootstrap, 95%
statistics.confirm_test: exact paired seed sign permutation with Holm family correction; report raw view effects separately
statistics.winner_probability: bootstrap probability of best, not a guarantee of global optimum
statistics.equivalence: if differences not resolved, report statistically indistinguishable candidate set rather than a unique optimum
statistics.model_effects: main factors plus registered interactions; grouped leave-one-configuration-out validation; effect-model assumptions explicit

final_evaluation: PSNR SSIM LPIPS photo, Cached actualK + common deterministic sameK; train/validation/test kept separate
execution: independent CUDA processes; no loss or optimizer merging; completed jobs resumable

Bank_only_supplement.reason: screen effect model grouped-LOO R2=0.138 cannot support isolated depth claims; add matched single-factor controls before any non-Bank quality inspection
Bank_only_supplement.selection: final Bank validation only; same-budget refit all candidates, locked winner then external evaluation; no test-driven architecture choice
